programmes.d: With more and more artists joining 9MAG, Ryan comes back as focused as ever on his growing shop. Charmaine cleans house at 2nd City and implements new restrictions that leave the crew at 9MAG wondering "What's going on with Charmaine?"
Sky goes behind Ceaser's back to open her boutique in Miami, Young Bae's mom pressures her daughter to get married in two weeks, and Donna's twin sister disapproves of Alex.
The shop is divided over Ceaser's choice to replace Sky, Young Bae and Rob receive devastating news, and Teddy flips when Tati gets wasted and goes home with another guy.
The crew parties in bougie Westchester, NY, before Bae's wedding, "father-of-the-bride" Ceaser is pissed to learn O'S**t is invited, and Tati tries to mend things with Teddy.
Sky's vengeful return and an emergency involving Rob throw Bae's wedding into chaos, Teddy and Tati make it official, and the fired employees of Black Ink come together.
Sky has a run-in with an enemy, Alex faces a medical emergency, Ceaser gets protective when his daughter goes on her first date, and a violent act leads to chaos at the shop.
An act of violence against the shop leaves the crew concerned, Black Ink gets a new receptionist, Teddy questions Tatiana's loyalty, and Alex receives heartbreaking news.
The crew helps Walt raise funds at a casino, Alex explores his legal options, Sky travels to Miami to look after her shop, and Ted and Tatiana's relationship hits a roadblock.
Donna teams up with Ceaser's enemy to take him down, the crew bets big to help Walt, and Sky's son Des meets his biological father, despite his mom's initial disapproval.
The crew throws a going-away party for Mama Bae, Alex moves into Donna's place, Ceaser receives devastating news, and Sky hosts the grand opening of her shop in Miami.
Sky enlists the crew to help with her fashion show in L.A., Miss Kitty and Young Bae talk about their fight, Alex surprises Donna, and Tatiana reaches her breaking point.
Ceaser reunites with an enemy, Krystal has a much-needed talk with her father, and Sky's twerk fashion show includes a surprise that sends Ceaser over the edge.
Free jackets get in the way of Ceaser squashing his beef with Alex, Tokie refuses to accept peace between Tati and Krystal, and Sky plows ahead with Operation Mend Fences.

After mending fences with Puma, Cease makes him a partner at 113th only to have his decision be questioned during his 40th birthday celebration. Bae struggles to keep her marriage together, while Sky confronts her son Des, about his recent behavior.
Walt brings his new girlfriend by the shop, which causes Donna to catch a flashback. Young Bae and Rob face difficulties in their marriage. Sky is at a crossroads with her relationship with Des.
Kit's mom passes away in D.C and the news rocks the shop. Donna and Walt duke it out over Jessica. Puma hires new girl London and Bae thinks he has a shady, ulterior motive.

Puma hires London to cover for Kitty which disrupts the precarious balance in the shop. Tati has a run in with the law and Donna faces a major financial setback. Puma tries to bring a little kumbaya to 113 but no good deed goes unpunished.

In an effort to support Miss Kitty, Ceaser and the crew head down to Memphis, Tennessee so she can reconnect with her mother's roots. Krystal confronts Donna about her behavior during the lock-in. And Walt makes a serious go at standup comedy.

The crew continues their stay in Memphis to pay their respects to Kitty's mom. London decides to throw a house party to promote the brand down south. Walt prepares to take his relationship with Jessica to the next step.

Don and Phor worry that Ryan might see their growth outside of the shop as disloyalty. As Draya settles into 9MAG, she finds out you can't run from all of your problems. Shogun throws a party to welcome all the new artists.

Ryan confronts his grandmother's passing and realizes he's been spread too thin between work and family. As several mysterious encounters with the ghost of 9MAG start to worry the crew, Draya invites a medium to the shop to clear the air.
After a long drought on the dating front, Don schemes to get Ryan on track to having a love life. Prince struggles to get through to his nephew, and enlists the help of "Sensei" Shogun.

Tensions reach new levels between Phor and Nina in the aftermath of the lingerie party. Draya takes a DNA test to see just how big her family really is. With Don's daughter and her mother living in a different state, Don struggles to reach them.

While 9MAG wraps up construction and celebrates the reopening of the shop, Don struggles with being a long-distance dad. A prank war between Prince and B-Slam takes Prince's tattoo experience into a different world.

9MAG hires a familiar face to work at the shop. With his dad's health deteriorating, Prince is forced to make changes for his future. Guys' night out takes a left turn when a surprise visit disrupts the party.
